description: This file defines the interface and implementation details for a factory class that creates player components such as audio and video decoders, renderers, and related configurations for Android in the Cobalt project. It includes classes for handling tunnel mode, audio sink creation, and component setup with support for various media formats and secure pipelines.

classes.name: AudioRendererSinkAndroid
classes.description: Custom audio renderer sink implementation supporting tunnel mode with specific audio session handling.

classes.name: AudioRendererSinkCallbackStub
classes.description: Stub callback for audio sink to handle source status and error reporting.

classes.name: PlayerComponentsPassthrough
classes.description: Implementation of player components that directly pass through audio and video renderers.

classes.name: PlayerComponentsFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and configuring media player components such as decoders and renderers, with support for tunnel mode and various media formats.

methods.name: CreateComponents
methods.description: Creates player components (audio/video decoders and renderers) based on creation parameters, supporting tunnel mode and format validation.

methods.name: CreateSubComponents
methods.description: Creates sub-components like decoders and renderers, handling tunnel mode support, MIME validation, and configuration.

methods.name: GetAudioRendererParams
methods.description: Calculates and returns parameters for audio renderer buffer sizes and cache.

methods.name: CreateVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates a video decoder with specific parameters, including HDR info and endianness.

methods.name: IsTunnelModeSupported
methods.description: Checks if tunnel mode is supported given creation parameters and sets secure pipeline requirements.

methods.name: GenerateAudioSessionId
methods.description: Generates a unique audio session ID for tunnel mode using Java environment calls.

methods.name: TryToCreateTunnelModeAudioRendererSink
methods.description: Attempts to create and verify an audio sink suitable for tunnel mode with specific sample rate and channel configurations.
